source_caption:
📺 90210 (2008–2013)

90210 follows Annie and Dixon Wilson, two siblings who move from Kansas to Beverly Hills, California, where they must adjust to life among wealthy teenagers at West Beverly Hills High School. As they navigate new friendships, complicated romances, school drama, and unexpected rivalries, they discover that life in Beverly Hills is far from perfect. Alongside classmates Naomi, Silver, Adrianna, and Navid, the siblings experience heartbreak, family conflicts, personal struggles, and life-changing decisions. Filled with emotional moments, surprising twists, and unforgettable relationships, 90210 explores friendship, love, ambition, betrayal, and the challenges of growing up in a glamorous but complicated world.

🎭 Genre: Teen Drama • Romance • Drama

⭐ IMDb: 6.2/10

⏱️ Runtime: Approximately 42 minutes per episode • TV-14

🎥 Developers: Rob Thomas, Gabe Sachs & Jeff Judah

source_details.synopsis: 90210 is an American teen drama television series developed by Rob Thomas, Gabe Sachs and Jeff Judah for The CW. It originally aired from September 2, 2008, to May 13, 2013, and is the fourth series in the franchise created by Darren Star. Like its predecessor, the show follows the lives of several wealthy students attending West Beverly Hills High School in Beverly Hills, California. The show later focuses on the same group of friends when they graduate and begin their lives in the adult world.
